name: Cobalt difluoride
equilibrium_context: Collinear antiferromagnet in the rutile structure, Neel temperature 39 K, piezomagnetic but without a net moment

driven_states.emergent_property: Nonlinear three-phonon mixing selectively generates crystal-field distortions that decompensate the compensated spin structure. What is produced is a ferrimagnetic moment of 0.2 Bohr magnetons per unit cell, about three orders of magnitude larger than what is achievable with mechanical strain.

drive.polarization: linear; the sign of the moment is bidirectionally controllable via the excitation geometry
drive.driven_mode: two infrared-active Eu modes whose sum-frequency mixing generates a Raman-active crystal-field distortion

driven_states.source: Disa, Fechner, Nova, Liu, Foerst, Prabhakaran, Radaelli & Cavalleri, Nature Physics 16, 937 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41567-020-0936-3
driven_states.caveat: Purely driven state without persistence. An Author Correction to the paper exists. The evidence is magneto-optical, and the moment is converted into absolute units in a model-dependent way.

threshold.quantity: no threshold, quadratic growth with the excitation amplitude

gaps: Field strength and fluence not verified.
